about: Steward sits between your app and the model: it lets on-mission questions through, politely redirects curious drift, blocks prompt injection, logs the cost of every request per feature and gives the business a dashboard.

features.title: Browser playground
features.body: Chat as different users, simulate traffic, watch the dashboard, correct the classifier and measure accuracy against a labelled evaluation set.

features.title: Allow, redirect or block
features.body: Every request is classified on-mission, curious drift or hostile injection, and handled accordingly.

features.title: Daily off-topic allowance
features.body: A THROTTLE outcome gives users a small off-topic budget per day instead of a hard no.

features.title: Unmet-demand report
features.body: See what people keep asking for that your assistant doesn't cover yet.

features.title: OpenAI-compatible proxy
features.body: A FastAPI proxy with an audit log and stats: point your client at it, nothing else changes.

features.title: SDKs for Python and TypeScript
features.body: The same guard in both languages, 11/11 tests passing in each.

features.title: Measured, not guessed
features.body: On the CAD-copilot policy the local classifier scores 85% on a final held-out set; an optional LLM judge is there for production.
